== Description ==

[[Benji Chu]] (right, black SWCCG cap and navy Yankees shirt) and his brother [[Apollo Chu]] (left, glasses and blue SpongeBob shirt) at an evening table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
